name: Heracross
description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target. Spike splinters left behind by this attack continue to damage the target for several turns.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Slash
moves.description: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This raises the user’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's defensive stats.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.description: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target to inflict damage.
